entries.rationale: Manifest validation for implement.batch_mode/max_batch_size mirrors the existing validateMaxReviewRetries() structurally; full test cases and validator code are supplied in the plan. Three files, one module (lib/manifest.mjs + its test + a commented manifest.yaml doc block). Purely mechanical config plumbing feeding Task 2.

The largest task: a six-row eligibility gate, abort carry-forward, and three artifact-level postcondition checks. Full pseudocode and test suites are given, and reviewRounds is a shipped projection (review-provenance.spec.md, status: validated), but combining six gate rows plus carry-forward is genuine new composition. Four new files, one new module.

adev implement batches directly mirrors adev parallel groups' CLI-verb-wraps-a-pure-parser shape and reuses lib/cli/parallel.mjs's emit()/argErr() helpers plus the existing read-routing subverb's exit-code convention. The plan deliberately elides the plumbing middle, leaving a small amount of wiring judgment. Two files, one module.

batched-mode.md is a structural mirror of parallel-mode.md, extracted for the same byte-cap reason; the plan supplies eight content points and the full doc-contract test verbatim. Two new files, one module. Requires careful prose phrasing to satisfy exact regex assertions.

SKILL.md wiring follows the exact --parallel precedent already in the file, with line numbers and markdown snippets fully specified. One file modified, tests already scaffolded by Task 4. Fully mechanical.

Doc updates for adev implement batches and --no-batch/--max-batch mirror the existing test-depth-policy-docs.test.mjs pattern, with target sections and the full test file given. Three files spanning docs/ and tests/docs/, otherwise mechanical.

2-arm equivalence eval mirrors the existing 3-arm worktree-parallelization harness, reusing judge()/renderReport() and Task 2's verify functions. Contract G is release-blocking and the live orchestration capture is deliberately left to implementation time, so genuine design judgment remains. Four new files, one new eval directory.
